inherits.unchanged: All leakage, source-binding, operation-context, sealing, independence and one-shot requirements remain unchanged.

v0_design_result.problem: The draft used a generic capability field/metric for cache-prefix, parameter replay and adjacent reorder, but the frozen ReplayCapabilityV1 schema only defines parameter-replay mechanisms.
v0_design_result.risk: Non-replay rewrites would be forced into mechanism=none and could be falsely reported Unsupported, or ReplayCapabilityV1 would silently be overclaimed as a generic rewrite-capability system.

only_scope_corrections: Rename analyzer bundle capability system to replay_capability system.
Rename capability_resolution_min to replay_capability_resolution_min and compute it only over registered_parameter_replay units.
Only registered_parameter_replay units may use rng_state_restoration or stored_parameter_record and must have a private expected replay-capability status.
candidate kinds none, cache_prefix and adjacent_swap require replay mechanism none and private expected replay-capability status not_applicable.
Final safe-admit recall for non-replay rewrites continues to use their frozen semantic/source/verification obligations; v1 makes no generic runtime-capability claim for them.
additional_falsification_rules: Do not include cache-prefix or adjacent-reorder units in the ReplayCapability resolution denominator.
Do not claim final-v2 has a generic rewrite-capability receipt; it has ReplayCapabilityV1 plus rewrite-specific verification plans.
A future generic RewriteCapability requires a separate protocol and evidence for cache/reorder mechanisms.
